# CEL Lint — clean KB whose only page is fresh

# Create a clean KB
exec akb init clean-cel-kb
cd clean-cel-kb

# init seeds no templates: copy the ones this scenario writes pages of.
exec akb template get note --full --examples
cp stdout .agent-kb/templates/note.yaml
exec git add .agent-kb/templates
exec git commit -m 'seed note template'

stdin ../fresh-note.md
exec akb write notes/fresh.md
stdout 'Written to kb/notes/fresh.md'

exec akb index add kb/notes/fresh.md 'Fresh note'

# In a clean KB with only fresh pages, the orphan warning is the only
# issue and lint still exits 0.
exec akb lint
stdout 'orphans'
! stdout 'note_stale'

# A successful exec already asserts exit code 0

-- fresh-note.md --
---
type: note
title: Fresh Note
summary: A recently updated note
tags: [linttest]
created: "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z"
updated: "2026-09-01T00:00:00Z"
---
This note is fresh.
